calculation.expression: (log_return_30d / downside_std_30d) * (1 if breadth_20d >= 0.35 else -0.5), lagged 1 day
calculation.description: Ranks assets by medium-horizon return normalized by downside volatility. When fewer than 35% of assets have positive 20-day returns, attenuate and reverse the signal to reduce pro-risk exposure during broad stress. All inputs use completed bars only.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across 3088 dates in the 15-asset synthetic cross-asset universe; average 13.65 valid instruments at the 20-day horizon. The intended 20-day horizon was positive, but the mandatory daily paper IC admission gate was not met.
